notes: Printer Bot 3.2.0-beta.5 is a prerelease, a test version of 3.2.0 that can have mistakes; it reaches you only with Try prerelease versions on. The rules now have a section of their own, Rules, under the printer cards: each rule chooses its printer, and a rule can be dragged anywhere in the list. Its last row, Everything else, takes every event that no rule takes. The rules are read from the top, like a firewall: the first rule an event matches decides its printer, paper and tray. The switch Do not stop at first match reads every rule, as before; it is on after the update, so your setup prints as it did. The handle of a rule no longer gets thin. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.2.0-beta.5 on GitHub.
